title: An IoT-Based Infrastructure Model for Reducing Urban Light Pollution: Empirical Assessment and System Design in Dhaka
description:
This repository provides the empirical datasets, hardware specifications, embedded control logic, reproduction scripts, and manuscript for the study: An IoT-Based Infrastructure Model for Reducing Urban Light Pollution: Empirical Assessment and System Design in Dhaka by Md Reyad Hasan and Ishrat Jahan Riya.

Key Contents:

  • Empirical Field Audit Dataset: In-situ ground-level photometric measurements across 13 distinct functional urban sectors in Dhaka, Bangladesh (including fashion retail, electronics corridors, transit nodes, residential areas, and hospitals). Available as standardized open CSV (data/dhaka_photometric_survey.csv) and archival multi-sheet Excel workbook (data/raw/Database (Light Pollution).xlsx).
  • Benchtop Experimental Dataset: 12 controlled benchtop luminaire trials isolating luminaire tilt orientation, vertical elevation, LED spectral wavelength, optical cutoff shielding geometry, and architectural window glazing attenuation (data/benchtop_experiments.csv).
  • IoT Hardware Architecture & Firmware Design: Engineering specifications for a vertically stratified four-zone smart streetlight node powered by the dual-core ESP32-S3 Sense microcontroller (utilizing SIMD vector acceleration). Features multi-modal sensor fusion across 7 modalities: OV2640 edge camera executing quantized TinyML vision models (YOLOv8-nano/MobileNet), HB100 microwave Doppler radar, sidewalk-directed PIR motion array, BH1750 ambient light sensor, BME280 atmospheric module, DS3231 TCXO real-time clock, and INA219 power telemetry monitor.
  • Sub-10 ms ESP-NOW Mesh Protocol: Connectionless OSI Layer-2 peer-to-peer communication framework broadcasting target velocity and heading to awaken a predictive ‘rolling luminescence bubble’ 30–40 m ahead of oncoming vehicles, restricting vehicular slip to 10–13 cm.
  • Deterministic Priority Arbitration Hierarchy: Six-tier conflict-resolution matrix and edge-case state machine enforcing automated post-midnight 50% skyglow curfews, weather-adaptive safety scaling, and a 100% full-beam fail-safe fallback.
  • Reproduction Scripts: Turnkey Python scripts (scripts/reproduce_tables.py) regenerating summary statistics for all tables in the paper.
  • Manuscript Source: Complete LaTeX source (paper/finalPaper.tex) and publication-ready PDF (paper/Light_Pollution.pdf).
